name: Recharge Trench
description: Contour-aligned trench to capture runoff and enhance infiltration.

name: Check Dam
description: Small barrier across seasonal stream to slow flow and recharge downstream springs.

name: Percolation Pond
description: Excavated pond that stores monsoon runoff for slow percolation.

name: Contour Trench
description: Staggered trenches along contours to reduce runoff on slopes.

name: Vegetation Restoration
description: Native species plantation to improve soil moisture and baseflow.

name: Spring-shed Treatment
description: Comprehensive treatment of springshed catchment including vegetative and engineering measures.

name: Drainage Treatment
description: Channelization and treatment of drainage lines to reduce erosion and improve percolation.

name: Infiltration Gallery
description: Subsurface gallery to collect and infiltrate monsoon runoff into aquifer.
